note: The independent physical-tier support ladder for the client release claim, owned by the product rather than by any single evidence file. A qualification that claims physical status (or any --release run) must partition this exact set: qualification.release_tiers (certified with device evidence) and qualification.pending_release_tiers (declared for measurement, release-blocking until evidence lands) are disjoint, their union equals required_physical_tiers, and pending_release_tiers must be present even when empty. An evidence file therefore cannot shrink the ladder by deleting the pending list or by omitting a tier.
